name: BigMarker
description: BigMarker is a webinar, virtual-event, and hybrid-event platform with conferences, series, meeting spaces, registration, engagement, recordings, analytics, and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated BigMarker API key through Railway's encrypted store, then retrieve only aggregate inventory metadata from one fixed first page of future conferences.

capabilities.label: Count future conferences
capabilities.description: Inspect only aggregate inventory metadata from one fixed first page of future conferences.

approvalRequired.label: Count future conferences
approvalRequired.description: Read one fixed first page and return only aggregate future-conference inventory metadata.

blocked.label: Conference identity and content
blocked.description: Conference, channel, series, meeting-space, presenter, and member IDs plus titles, descriptions, addresses, schedules, branding, tags, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and engagement
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, presenters, subscribers, contact details, access links, attendance, polls, questions, chats, surveys, and analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Media and privileged access
blocked.description: Recordings, transcripts, downloads, reports, admin URLs, enter URLs, credentials, media, webhooks, and communications are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Conference, series, registration, presenter, subscriber, poll, block-list, recording, meeting-space, and every other mutation plus arbitrary origins, paths, IDs, filters, pages, bodies, and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every account-wide aggregate future-conference read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected aggregate reads run without Relay per-action approval while account binding, fixed origin and endpoint, first-page bounds, record exclusion, audits, encrypted credentials, and BigMarker rate limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware BigMarker aggregate future-conference inventory tool using an encrypted API key.
Railway mounts one approval-aware BigMarker aggregate future-conference inventory tool using an encrypted API key.

providerSetup.blocker: A BigMarker administrator must generate a dedicated API key on the documented www.bigmarker.com base, configure it through Railway's encrypted connector setup, confirm account/channel authorization, and complete staging acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Generate a dedicated key, store it only through Railway's encrypted connector setup, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous aggregate reads, verify rotation and local disconnect, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance without exposing conference records.

evidence.supports: BigMarker documents API-KEY authentication, the fixed GET /api/v1/conferences/ route, page/role/per_page/type controls, pagination totals, conference content fields Relay excludes, and broad adjacent privileged/write surfaces.
BigMarker documents administrator API-key generation and rotation, per-account base URLs, a 100-call-per-minute general API limit, and distinct registration limits.
